data.name: Isamel
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Ἰσάμελ (Isamel), which is a combination of two elements: isos (equal) and helios (sun). In Greek mythology, Helios is the god of the sun. The name Isamel thus means 'equal to the sun god'. In a Christian context, it can be interpreted as 'God of El' or 'Equal to God'.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing devotion and faith in God.
data.numerology_meaning: Creative, artistic, and sociable individuals who are driven by their emotions.

in_english.name: Isamel
in_english.meaning: God's power, strength of God, power of God
in_english.long_meaning: Derived from Hebrew 'izzim' (strength, power) and 'El' (God), Isamel signifies the power, strength, or might of God. In Christian tradition, it symbolizes spiritual empowerment, courage, and resilience. As a given name, Isamel is often associated with biblical figures, such as the sons of Jacob (Genesis 30:8-10, 30:11-13) and is also linked to the concept of divine authority. In modern times, Isamel is used across Christian cultures to represent a strong connection with God's power and presence.
